title: MCP request routing and tool execution pipeline
answers: How does an MCP request flow from edge to tool execution in services/mcp?
Where are incoming MCP JSON-RPC requests authenticated, dispatched, and handled?
What is the entry point for /mcp HTTP requests?
body:
1. `services/mcp/src/index.ts:fetch` receives incoming `/mcp` requests, validates bearer tokens (`phx_`, `pha_`, idJag), and proxies via `services/mcp/src/proxy.ts:proxyToHono` to regional Hono instances.
2. `services/mcp/src/hono/app.ts:createApp` routes `/mcp` traffic into `services/mcp/src/hono/streamable-handler.ts:StreamableMcpHandler.fetch`.
3. `services/mcp/src/hono/request-utils.ts:authenticateAndParse` re-validates credentials and extracts the JSON-RPC request body.
4. `services/mcp/src/hono/dispatcher.ts:McpDispatcher.handleRequest` invokes `dispatchMethod` for JSON-RPC methods (`tools/call`, `initialize`, `server/discover`).
5. `services/mcp/src/hono/request-state-resolver.ts:RequestStateResolver.resolve` loads org/project metadata and detects client capabilities via `services/mcp/src/lib/client-detection.ts:MCPClientProfile`.
6. `services/mcp/src/hono/tool-executor.ts:ToolExecutor.handleToolCall` executes either the umbrella `exec` tool (`services/mcp/src/tools/exec.ts:callExecTool`) or individual handlers in `services/mcp/src/tools/generated/*` using `services/mcp/src/api/client.ts:ApiClient`.
7. `services/mcp/src/lib/build-tool-result.ts:buildToolResultPayload` formats and estimates token size for the returned tool call payload.
